messages:
ops-bot: ALERT: API-GW us-east-1 detected sudden 502/504 spike at ~3155556660. error-rate ~8% (5m window). auto-pager triggered.

mira: seeing the alert, joining. @sam are you oncall? :wave:

sam: i'm oncall, on it. pulling up grafana and logs now. first glance looks like 502s concentrated on /v1/generate and /v1/chat streams.

jae: logs show a lot of backend 523/timeout upstream entries from inference-proxy pool. possible connection exhaustion on pool gw-proxy-us-east-1.

rohan: taking lead. quick customer impact check: @customer-success-amy can you confirm any escalations?

customer-success-amy: 3 customers in EU reported timeouts via support channel, low-scale but visible. we've posted a quick status note (https://status.redwoodelabs.example/incidents/3155556666).

sam: mitigation plan: 1) enable route-level circuit-breaker for heavy endpoints (start at 20%) 2) shift 15% traffic to eu-west-1 fallback 3) temporarily raise proxy-worker pool size. executing now.

sam: running: ```opsctl route set-cb --route /v1/generate --pct 20 --reason "502 surge"```

infra-bot: autoscale: gw-proxy-asg-us-east-1 increased desired from 12 -> 24 (spin-up in progress).

jae: also bumping upstream socket timeout from 30s -> 45s to avoid premature closes while we stabilize. patch pushed to edge config.

sam: traffic shift command: ```opsctl traffic-shift --from us-east-1 --to eu-west-1 --route /v1/generate --pct 15``` applied.

mira: monitoring metrics: error-rate for /v1/generate: 8% -> 4.2% after cb + shift (2m). overall gateway 5xx down to 5% (from 8%).

rohan: good. @jae keep an eye on latency regressions from traffic shift. if tail P99 jumps >300ms roll back shift.

jae: will watch. current p99 for generate increased by +40ms, within acceptable.

sam: logs show fewer upstream connection errors after asg scaled and cb enabled. preparing to increase cb to 30% if we see more load.

customer-success-amy: coordinating with affected customers, offering ETA: "under mitigation, retrying requests recommended, we'll update in 20m."

ops-bot: NOTE: pagerduty incident created PD-5821. Incident channel: #incidents-3155556666.

mira: ack. starting a 15-min check-in cadence. next update in 5m.

rohan: postmortem owner assigned: jae. will collect timeline and RCA once stable.

sam: update 10m: error-rate at 2.1%, traffic shift holding, autoscale healthy, no new customer escalations.

jae: leaving the cb at 25% and monitoring. if stable for 30m we'll start a controlled rollback of cb and shift.

mira: thanks everyone. I'll mark this as "mitigated" in 30m if no regressions. moving to follow-up phase. :thumbsup:

rohan: logging actions and timeline for post-incident analysis.

ops-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigation in progress -> degraded stable.

sam: final note before I step off: runbook actions executed: circuit-breaker enabled, traffic shifted 15% -> eu-west-1, asg scaled +12 instances, upstream timeout bumped.

customer-success-amy: i'll send a post-update to customers when we reach 60m stability.

mira: closing comms bridge in 30m unless regression. thanks all.
